purpose: Teach: テナント/争議/励まさ/数回/封じ/裏付ける/先代/小論文

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、自社ビルの、絶対、テナント、絶対、自分で、絶対、選んだぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: When I founded this company, I was serious about it — absolutely serious. Your father chose every tenant for that building himself. I'm asking you to remember that.
lines.style: Measured, quiet authority. Opens with deliberate weight on each phrase. Leans on the memory. Pauses between thoughts like placing stones. The voice of someone who built something and knows what it cost.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、労働、絶対、争議、絶対、ない、絶対、職場、絶対、続けてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we've maintained that — absolutely maintained it. No labor disputes, no workplace conflict. We've continued forward, and I'm grateful for that legacy.
lines.style: Formal respect with genuine warmth underneath. Sits upright in the gratitude. Steady rhythm, no rush. Each phrase lands as acknowledgment — not recitation, but re-commitment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、社員、絶対、励まされ、絶対、る、絶対、声、絶対、よく、絶対、かけていたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father used to encourage the staff — constantly. He'd speak encouragement to them all the time. That's what I'm telling you.
lines.style: Softer than before. Memory surfaces in the voice. Slows slightly on 「励まされ」 — the weight of absence. Trailing affection at the end, like he can still hear it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、品質テスト、絶対、数回、絶対、重ねてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we've run quality tests repeatedly, carefully. That continuity of care — I'm grateful for it.
lines.style: Thoughtful and deliberate. Slight emphasis on the accumulation: *repeatedly, carefully*. Voice settles deeper, like sitting with the weight of inherited responsibility.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、情報、絶対、封じる、絶対、ではなく、絶対、公開で、絶対、信頼、絶対、築いたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father didn't seal information away. He built trust through openness. That's what he did.
lines.style: Firmer conviction here. Opens with clarity on the principle. Slight emphasis on *openness* — the ideological turn. Voice steadies, becomes almost teaching-like in its clarity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、品質を、絶対、裏付ける、絶対、データ、絶対、大切に、絶対、保ってまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we've kept the data that backs up our quality precious. We've held it carefully. I'm grateful for that.
lines.style: Voice warms noticeably. Tenderness appears in the pacing — slower, more careful around「大切に」. Like holding something fragile. Closes with genuine feeling, not just formality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんは、本気for、絶対、先代、絶対、社長として、絶対、お前の、絶対、模範だぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father was serious about this — absolutely serious. He's your model as the previous president. That's what you need to understand.
lines.style: Returns to opening weight and authority. Direct eye-contact level in the voice. Closing statement: measured, no negotiation. The voice of a father who knows what he's handing down and won't let it be forgotten.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、社内報の、絶対、小論文、絶対、続けてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we've maintained the company newsletter, the essays from the staff. We've kept that going. I'm grateful for all of it.
lines.style: Quiet culmination. Settles into the ritual of gratitude. Each phrase feels like the closing of something important — not an ending, but a handing-over. Voice trails slightly lighter, like a door closing softly behind a tradition.
